notes.title: New review from the Kuplinov (15.3 million subscribers!) and Chapter2 update
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to share that we have received a new review from one of the most popular gamers in Eastern Europe, Kuplinov, who has an impressive subscriber count of 15.3 million. We invite you to check out the review and show your support by leaving comments, liking the video, and sharing it with your friends. If you prefer to read the review in English, we recommend using the Chrome extension provided at this link: http://go.locgame.io/xg2Ed6 for instant translation.

Given the current challenging market conditions, RBL Labs - the studio behind IKTP Chapter 1 has made the decision to focus on our core business model of mobile casual web3 games from Q3 2023. We are incredibly grateful for the experience and great times we have shared with the team behind IKTP Chapter 1. They have become an integral part of our RBL family, and we sincerely wish them continued success with this amazing quest. 

Want to get involved and contribute to the success of IKTP as a partner or investor? Please reach out directly to the developers team via https://t.me/IKTP_RU to explore how you can help bring the next chapters to the market. Together, we can continue creating an unforgettable gaming experience for players around the world!
